self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Swift and Sure: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam grants an additional +24% Lunar-Charged DMG (4-star modeled at R5).

en.flavor: A polearm that appears to have been crafted from a metal agricultural tool. At first glance, it could not look more ordinary, yet its discreet design hides fittings that are both lavish and undeniably exquisite.

refinements.1: Electro-Charged DMG is increased by <r>48%</r>, and Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by <r>12%</r>. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by an additional <r>12%</r>.
refinements.2: Electro-Charged DMG is increased by <r>60%</r>, and Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by <r>15%</r>. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by an additional <r>15%</r>.
refinements.3: Electro-Charged DMG is increased by <r>72%</r>, and Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by <r>18%</r>. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by an additional <r>18%</r>.
refinements.4: Electro-Charged DMG is increased by <r>84%</r>, and Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by <r>21%</r>. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by an additional <r>21%</r>.
refinements.5: Electro-Charged DMG is increased by <r>96%</r>, and Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by <r>24%</r>. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged DMG is increased by an additional <r>24%</r>.

fr.flavor: Une arme qui semble avoir été fabriquée à partir d'un outil agricole. À première vue, elle paraît on ne peut plus ordinaire, mais sa conception discrète cache des particularités à la fois somptueuses et indéniablement raffinées.
